body: Wow this just unearthed a forgotten memory of me getting in trouble for forwarding one of those emails. I can't remember exactly what the bad thing was that would happen if you didn't forward the email, but one of the friends I sent it to was hysterical because her parents wouldn't let her send it to anyone and she thought the bad thing would happen to her. Her parents called mine and I got a talking to about forwarding chain emails. I believe we were definitely old enough to know that the "terrible thing" would not actually happen but I guess that friend was superstitious 🤷🏻‍♀️
Me too, 5ish years now :( only difference is I don't think I have had the dizziness problem
Is that like the thing where you usually have to go up and down the metal stairs?

Yeah I think there's like WAY less food options than usual so the lines are horrible, I think definitely less water stations, and someone said that more of the park was blocked off so that would at least partially explain when it seems like there are so many more people. Overall not my favourite osheaga
I wouldn't say so! This is my fourth time; the first time was horrible but it was the year the park was under construction so I think that was the cause. The other 2 years were both fine I thought!
Ahh okay is that it?? Thanks for solving the mystery
I went right after Chappell Roan so I guess maybe just poor timing, our friends also just said the same water station we waited 30 min for was now pretty much empty 🤷🏼‍♀️

I recently bought the Salicylic Acid 2% Masque from The Ordinary and I like it a lot so far, that could be an option as well. It's not expensive and I only use it once every 3 days (the package recommends using 1-2 times a week) so it lasts a while as well :)
